hero.h1: Strategy that becomes commits. Commits that become value.
hero.lead: I orchestrate teams and AI agents to deliver critical software, with proof in every delivery.
hero.sub: I'm Victor Caldeira, 18 years in technology, across payments fintech and e-commerce. What drives me is turning strategy into delivery: more efficient teams, a value-driven roadmap and performance that holds up in production.
of.sub: Four areas I specialized in, each tied to where I have applied it.
of.1: I built an agentic squad organized around business domains, with Spec-Driven Development: more productivity and more quality in every delivery, with AI at the center of the process.
of.2: Budget, roadmap and strategic planning, team decomposition and structuring, business and engineering KPIs.
of.3: Identifying bottlenecks and waste across development teams, infrastructure and FinOps, tools and processes, with AI at the center of the analysis.
of.4: Four M&As in my career, three of them leading the technology front, including post-acquisition integration.
cases.sub: Four deliveries told the way I work: diagnosis, build and proof. I talk about engineering and people, not business numbers.
es.meta: Greenn Pagamentos · 2025–2026 · CTO · spec-driven development and AI agents
es.lede: AI agents with separate roles: one diagnoses, one builds and one tries to break it. Every round leaves the evidence ready.
es.cap: How a request moves through the pipeline: every gate is a person saying yes.
es.s2: AI qualifies it and suggests a priority.
es.s4: Business spec and prototype, generated by an agent in a standardized way.
es.s6: A product engineer picks it up and writes the technical spec.
es.s7: Technical approval with an architect or a peer tech lead.
es.s11: A human reviews the tested criteria and the business rules.
es.s12: A peer or lead reviews the code, with an agent and as a human.
es.s13: Atomic PRs from development to merge.
es.s16: Next delivery: the cycle starts again.
